Alex K: Helios CTO wants answers before 15:00 touchpoint: SSO/KMS, pilot pricing tiers, and latency for 100-500 conc. Can we triage?
Maria (sales): Need delta for 100k / 1M / 10M tokens/day. Also confirm seat vs usage for pilot.
Sanjay: I'll run concurrency sweep on dedicated-2 (nv24): 50/200/500. Posting p50/p95/p99.
Lisa (security): Got their questionnaire. Flagged 4 blockers (KMS BYO, retention, SOC2 scope, VPC). Drafting replies but need product signoff on retention.
Jordan (CS): They require Okta SAML + SCIM. I'll validate SSO and provide runbook snippet.
ops-bot: perf job 9832 queued on dedicated-2. ETA ~15m.
Sanjay: 50c interim: p50 98ms / p95 220ms. 200c running. Logs: s3://redwood-tests/9832/results.log
Maria (sales): Trial discount? We can approve up to 20% promo credit if they commit to 6mo reserved conversion; >20% needs RevOps/CRO.
Lisa (security): KMS BYO supported with key-wrap + IAM role. I'll include templated snippet in questionnaire.
Sanjay: 200c results: p50 210ms p95 500ms p99 1.1s. 500c ramping; if p95>1.5s suggest autoscale + kv-cache pruning.
Alex K: Preparing 1-slide exec ask: trial discount + SSO/KMS checklist + capacity SLA (500c sustained 30m). Meet 14:45 PT to finalize?
All: :thumbsup: (confirmations)
ops-bot: calendar invite created 14:45 PT.
Alex K: After sync I'll post the slide + next steps.
